answer: A courier device signs each drop inside a hardware enclave, and payment releases only after three unrelated agents confirm the parcel arrived. The auditor pool rotates, so a farm cannot buy the same three reviewers twice. Ten ghost riders therefore cost ten devices and ten failed drops on the voyage, not ten free accounts. Idle clones sit in a lagoon with no confirmed drops, and no route reaches its zenith without witnesses who are not on the payroll.
